exceptions.title: renders a panel that suspends when opened with the boundary outside the root
exceptions.reason: React hides the mounted tree and shows the fallback when a panel suspends after the mount. Vue keeps a resolved Suspense branch when the same root component mounts an async descendant.

The root uses 0 when `defaultValue` is absent or undefined. An uncontrolled root with that implicit default can fall back from a disabled tab on mount and emit an initial change. An explicit `defaultValue={0}` keeps a disabled tab with value 0 on mount. The root applies the default in setup to distinguish these cases.
Base UI turns this file into `prehydrationScript.min.ts` with a minifier. Vase UI copies the resulting script text into its prehydration module. Its components use that module.

surfaceAdditions.reason: The part reads `id` to give it to the root for the `aria-labelledby` of the panel, so it is a declared prop. Base UI reads it from the native attributes of the tab, and `types.md` has no row for a native attribute.

The part reads `id` to give it to the root for the `aria-controls` of the tab, so it is a declared prop. `types.md` has no row for a native attribute. Base UI gives the root a generated id, and an `id` of the consumer replaces only the id of the element.
